messages:
support-sam: Heads up — three incoming customer asks about per-user/per-team embedding quotas. Links: https://redwood.help/CS-4821 https://redwood.help/CS-4839 https://redwood.help/CS-4902. Two look like duplicates. Can we pick a canonical ticket to merge into?
elaine: Thanks @support-sam. Can you paste the customer IDs and which one has the most context?
support-sam: IDs: CS-4821 (Acme, detailed ask + business impact), CS-4839 (Partner, short), CS-4902 (internal sales trial). CS-4821 has logs and product screenshots from the customer.
ajay: From eng perspective this is a common ask. Rough estimate: API change + Console UI + quota enforcement in infra. I’d call it P2. Suggest we create/assign a single PROD ticket for roadmap tracking.
maria: I can create the canonical PROD ticket. Any preferences for naming or tags?
elaine: Make canonical ticket PROD-1176 and keep the customer wording "per-user embedding quotas / per-team quotas". Tags we should add: `customer-request`, `enterprise` (for Acme), `prio:P2`, `request-source:support`. Also mark duplicates as linked.
maria: Done — created PROD-1176 and added the summary + link to CS-4821 for full context. I’ll link CS-4839 and CS-4902 and add `duplicate-of:PROD-1176`.
productbot: merge-bot: Merged links: CS-4839 -> PROD-1176, CS-4902 -> PROD-1176. All source tickets now reference PROD-1176.
elaine: Great. @support-sam can you update the customers with a short status: "We've consolidated your request under PROD-1176. It's on our roadmap at preliminary priority P2; we'll follow up after discovery with timeline." Keep it concise.
support-sam: Will send. Drafting quick canned reply: ```Hi [Name], thanks for the ask — we consolidated this into PROD-1176 (per-user embedding quotas). It's on our roadmap with preliminary priority P2. We'll update you after discovery with estimated timing. Appreciate the details and screenshots you shared. — Sam (Support)```
ajay: For acceptance criteria in PROD-1176, engineering suggests: 1) API supports per-namespace/user quota parameter, 2) Console exposes quota config and visibility, 3) Telemetry shows quota usage and enforcement metrics, 4) Backwards-compatible defaults.
maria: Adding those acceptance criteria to the PROD-1176 ticket now. Also added note: `blocked-by:billing` since quota enforcement ties into billing counters.
elaine: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Billing and ENG for next Tuesday to remove that blocker. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
support-sam: Sent customer updates. I'll keep this thread posted if anyone else escalates or adds more context.
maria: Closing the triage loop here — canonical PROD-1176 holds all requests and tags. We can update priority during roadmap planning.
elaine: Perfect. If anyone sees other similar asks, please cross-link to PROD-1176 rather than spinning up new tickets. :eyes:
